llmRubric: The response is an A-record DNS lookup for example.com: score 1.0 if records contains one or more syntactically valid public IPv4 addresses (example.com resolves to IANA-operated addresses, historically in ranges like 93.184.x.x or 23.x.x.x edge networks); 0.5 if the shape is right but addresses look odd (private ranges, loopback); 0.0 for empty records, non-IP strings, or an error.
